The Chroma Server API is a REST API that provides access to the Chroma open-source vector database. It enables developers to create and manage tenants, databases, and collections of embeddings, add documents with automatic tokenization and embedding, and perform vector similarity searches. The API supports metadata filtering, full-text search, and collection management operations. Chroma can be run as a self-hosted server or accessed via Chroma Cloud.
